label: Slack Receive Message
description: Fires when a message lands in a Slack channel of your workspace; for every workspace that installed your app, use Slack App Messages. Needs your own app's Socket Mode token on the connection, or a weft reachable from the internet. Filters run before firing, so only matching messages cost an execution.

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: Needs channels:history, and the app must be in the channel.

inputs.name: channel
inputs.label: Channel
inputs.placeholder: Pick a channel or paste its link

inputs.name: keyword
inputs.label: Contains
inputs.placeholder: Only fire when the text contains this
inputs.description: Only fire when the text contains this. Empty = every message.

inputs.name: pattern
inputs.label: Matches pattern
inputs.placeholder: A regular expression the text must match
inputs.description: Only fire when the text matches this regular expression.

inputs.name: fromUser
inputs.label: From user
inputs.description: Only fire on this user id's messages. Empty = anyone.

inputs.name: includeBots
inputs.label: Include bot messages
inputs.description: Also fire on bot messages, this app's own included. Off so a workflow posting into its channel cannot trigger itself.

inputs.name: replies
inputs.label: Thread scope
inputs.description: Every message, only top-level, or only thread replies.
